features.name: 8-agent Hive fabric
features.description: A team of specialised AI sub-agents Claude can hand work to: an architect, a builder, an inspector, an ops engineer, a scout, a scribe, a tester, and a librarian — each with its own role, model, and tool set.
features.notes: Definitions in .claude/agents/*.md; invoked via the Agent tool with subagent_type=hive-<role>

features.name: Dispatch discipline
features.description: A standing rule that turns the main Claude thread into a dispatcher rather than a do-everything worker — every multi-step task is routed to the right specialist.
features.notes: DISPATCH_PROTOCOL.md; main thread = orchestrator, one level of delegation deep

features.name: Model-tiered cost control
features.description: Cheap tasks go to cheap models (Haiku ops/scout/scribe/tester), design goes to the premium model (Opus architect), code and review to the workhorse (Sonnet). Premium reasoning is never burned on trivia.
features.notes: model pinned per agent in the front-matter (opus / sonnet / haiku)

features.name: Honest attribution
features.description: Work is tagged to the agent that actually did it; the main thread never claims credit for a sub-agent it didn't dispatch.
features.notes: Anti-fake-attribution rule in the protocol; SubagentStop hook records the real agent

features.name: Cross-project health scan
features.description: One command walks every registered QI project and reports a red / yellow / green status for each, so the whole ecosystem's health is visible at a glance.
features.notes: supervisor.py reads qi_registry.json and inspects each project

features.name: Drift detection
features.description: Flags the small problems that compound: uncommitted git changes, stale commits, stopped services, scheduled tasks that failed, and keepalive failure files.
features.notes: git status + NSSM service state + scheduled-task results + *failure-state*.json scan

features.name: Human dashboard
features.description: Produces a plain-language DASHBOARD.md with a summary line and a per-project findings table that the owner can read top to bottom.
features.notes: C:\APPS\CLAUDE\DASHBOARD.md, regenerated each run

features.name: Feeds the Hive Mission Control
features.description: The same scan updates the QI Hive dashboard's live status panels, so supervision shows up on the operational console too.
features.notes: writes C:\QIH\data\status.json consumed by the Hive dashboard

features.name: Every session leaves a trace
features.description: When a session ends, a summary stub is automatically dropped into the Hive inbox and ingested into the Brain — even if Claude forgot to log it explicitly.
features.notes: SessionEnd hook -> QI Hive inbox -> QI_HiveIngest -> qi_brain.db

features.name: Session-start ecosystem briefing
features.description: Every session opens with the full QI landscape pre-loaded: memory index, standing rules, a live Brain snapshot, and the dispatch reminder.
features.notes: SessionStart hook (global) injects additionalContext; fails LOUD if Brain is unreachable

features.name: Sub-agent work logged by role
features.description: When a sub-agent finishes, its work is recorded against the correct Hive role for accurate cross-project memory.
features.notes: SubagentStop hook normalises the agent name to hive_<role>

features.name: Pending-audit gate at session start
features.description: If a monthly self-audit is awaiting review, the session opens by presenting the findings and a decision gate before any new work.
features.notes: reads PENDING_REVIEW.json; surfaced in the SessionStart context

features.name: Clean-restart of Claude Desktop
features.description: Fixes the 'file in use' failure that used to force a full reboot — diagnoses and clears the orphaned MCP processes that lock the Claude install.
features.notes: claude_restart_guard.ps1 + Claude-Clean-Restart.bat; never touches QI_ services

features.name: Monthly self-audit
features.description: On the last Friday of the month it automatically tidies the working environment (kills orphans, prunes stale worktrees, trims config bloat) and reports anything that needs a human decision.
features.notes: QI_ClaudeSelfAudit scheduled task; --apply-safe auto-fixes; rest goes to the decision gate

features.name: LINE notification
features.description: Pushes a short heads-up to the owner over the Tasuke LINE account when the audit runs or something needs attention.
features.notes: qi_tasuke_notify.py — LINE broadcast, no stored userId needed

features.name: Safe-by-design automation
features.description: Auto-fixes are restricted to provably safe actions (orphan kill, clean-worktree removal, dead config entries). Anything risky is only reported for a human to decide.
features.notes: self-audit splits auto_fixed vs needs_decision; QI_ services explicitly protected

features.name: Keep the Brain in sync with reality
features.description: Scripts register new projects, refresh each project's recorded state, merge mislabelled session IDs, and backfill sessions that were never logged — so the Brain's memory matches what actually happened.
features.notes: brain_reconcile_2026_06_10.py; run-on-demand reconciliation passes

features.name: Registry-driven everywhere
features.description: Every tool reads the single ecosystem registry for paths and ports rather than hardcoding them, so a project move or port change propagates automatically.
features.notes: all tooling reads C:\QIH\ecosystem\qi_registry.json

features.name: Secrets & environment migration
features.description: One-off tooling to move secrets out of code and migrate environment configuration safely across the ecosystem.
features.notes: secrets_migration_round2.py, maia_env_migration.py

features.name: Continuous drift watchdog
features.description: Promote the on-demand supervisor scan into an always-on watchdog that alerts on drift the moment it appears.
features.notes: supervisor currently run-on-demand; watchdog service not yet stood up
